project.name: QRP :: On-chain
project.description: An on-chain DeFi asset class for the platform: reads the swap history ../onchain/'s constant-product AMM pool produced on a local Anvil fork (via tools/amm_sim.py) and computes an LP's impermanent loss against a hold-both-assets benchmark, plus the pool's cumulative fee income as a stand-in for a market maker's captured spread.
